comments.text: Tip [PLATE REDACTED] and beyond.  Get yourself a can of ceramic grease and forget about all the others.  Its high temp, non conductive, and works as an anti seize behind the disks, anti rattle behind the pads, and slider pin grease.  As an afterthought,  it's probably not useful in the bedroom,  but if you have round door knobs, it will help keep the kids out.  As far as copper, there are so many electrical connections around the brakes these days that a conductive material can present a problem if it gets into a clip.  Keep it simple.
